name: net_prologue_struggle_orbs
description: VUH-2865, PC1 loopback from FM-01 with a host warp to the Day 5 Struggle (02/05 btl84, site tt05-84, Hayner). Shipped defaults: the friend sees and collects the host's orbs (protocol 34, rule A in docs/PROLOGUE_ENCOUNTERS.md). First a staged brush-past, three passes: the host walks away from Hayner, the friend alone fights until 6 orbs are born, backs off, then walks straight through the uncollected births' centroid and 250 units past it, with paired 20 s clips and both seats' actor paths recorded (brush_paths.csv); whether the friend's clone on the host collects what the friend brushes through is read from those, not asserted. Then both seats fight until the host's match ends; the friend must end once, like the host, with worker-hook receipts marshalled to its entity thread. Rehearsal warp, not opening-route evidence. No save.
